刷新全部已命名视图与预览

zh: 双击组合进入隔离编辑，单击植物调整。右键组合可重命名、修改图层、显示或锁定；列表与视口双向选择。
en: Double-click a group to edit in isolation; select a plant to adjust it. Right-click a group to rename, change layer, show or lock. List and viewport selections stay synchronized.

shortEn: Double-click: edit · Right-click: manage · Selection syncs.

zh: 图片已导入；请在高级设置中确认实际尺寸。
en: Image imported; confirm its physical dimensions in advanced settings.

zh: 在 Rhino 中选择物件后可应用材质
en: Select Rhino objects to apply a material.

zh: 在网页中先做整图探索与标注修改，再对满意的结果进行高清细化。图片、版本和画板自动保存在本机；原始 PSD 保留，最终导出 PNG。显示语言可在网页设置中调整。

shortZh: 单株移动、缩放、镜像与复制；完成后调整布局。
shortEn: Edit one plant; finish before changing the layout.

en: Move in viewport · Snap to host surface

zh: 复杂曲面需要接缝。材质工具会自动补算缺失的真实尺寸 UV，通常无需手动准备。

shortZh: 太阳同时影响预览与阴影；不含反射 / GI / AO。
shortEn: Shared sun; shadows exclude reflections / GI / AO.

将当前 Rhino 视口保存为已命名视图

shortEn: No exports yet; choose a local PSD.

zh: 尺寸、外观与随机去重复可在下方“铺贴与外观设置”调整。
en: Adjust dimensions, appearance and random variation under Mapping and appearance.
shortZh: 尺寸与去重复见下方外观设置。
shortEn: Scale and variation are below in appearance settings.

zh: 尺寸与外观参数已保存，下次应用生效。
en: Dimensions and appearance saved; used next time you apply the material.

zh: 已保存；自定义植物计入密度和间距。

shortEn: Saved; custom plants count toward density and spacing.

zh: 应用材质前会自动补算缺失或失效的 UV

shortZh: 缺失 UV 自动准备

en: No plant groups in this model. Create one in Plants · Library.
shortZh: 尚无组合；在植物库创建。
shortEn: No groups yet. Create one in Plants.

zh: 手工植物保留位置，只参与大小衰减。

Drag or double-click a library plant.

shortEn: Drag: orbit · Wheel: zoom · Write to change Named View.

en: Material selected; click Apply to use it.

shortEn: No PSD yet; export one first.

保存并关闭 Rhino 以更新
en: Save and close Rhino to update

zh: 退出时仍由 Rhino 询问是否保存。取消退出不会强制关闭。更新和卸载保留素材库、画板与账号授权。
en: Rhino still asks whether to save on exit; cancelling never forces it closed. Updates and uninstall retain libraries, boards and account authorization.
shortZh: 退出时仍由 Rhino 询问是否保存。取消退出不会强制关闭。更新和卸载保留素材库、画板与账号授权。
shortEn: Rhino still asks whether to save on exit; cancelling never forces it closed. Updates and uninstall retain libraries, boards and account authorization.

zh: 当前：沙盒（禁止正式安装与更新）
shortZh: 当前：沙盒（禁止正式安装与更新）

zh: 已通过 ChatGPT 登录 Codex
shortZh: 已通过 ChatGPT 登录 Codex

zh: 检测到 API Key 登录；当前生图流程需要 ChatGPT 登录
en: API-key sign-in detected; current image workflow requires ChatGPT sign-in
shortZh: 检测到 API Key 登录；当前生图流程需要 ChatGPT 登录
shortEn: API-key sign-in detected; current image workflow requires ChatGPT sign-in

zh: 等待浏览器／设备码授权
shortZh: 等待浏览器／设备码授权

zh: 正在检查 GitHub 发行版本…
shortZh: 正在检查 GitHub 发行版本…

en: Up to date with public stable releases
shortEn: Up to date with public stable releases

zh: 仓库尚未公开，或尚无公开稳定版；不影响当前使用。
en: Repository is private or has no public stable release; current use is unaffected.
shortZh: 仓库尚未公开，或尚无公开稳定版；不影响当前使用。
shortEn: Repository is private or has no public stable release; current use is unaffected.

zh: GitHub 请求受限，请稍后重试。
en: GitHub rate limit reached; try later.
shortZh: GitHub 请求受限，请稍后重试。
shortEn: GitHub rate limit reached; try later.

zh: 无法连接更新服务，请检查网络后重试。
en: Update service unavailable; check your network and retry.
shortZh: 无法连接更新服务，请检查网络后重试。
shortEn: Update service unavailable; check your network and retry.

zh: 正在下载和校验安装包…
shortZh: 正在下载和校验安装包…

zh: 安装包已校验，可退出后安装。
en: Installer verified; ready to install after exit.
shortZh: 安装包已校验，可退出后安装。
shortEn: Installer verified; ready to install after exit.

zh: 下载或校验失败，旧版本未修改。
en: Download or verification failed; installed version unchanged.
shortZh: 下载或校验失败，旧版本未修改。
shortEn: Download or verification failed; installed version unchanged.

zh: 此安装包尚未配置发布者签名，自动安装暂不可用。
en: Publisher signing is not configured in this build; automatic installation is unavailable.
shortZh: 此安装包尚未配置发布者签名，自动安装暂不可用。
shortEn: Publisher signing is not configured in this build; automatic installation is unavailable.

zh: 用于后续季节版本，不会自动重新生成已有图片。
en: Used for new seasonal variants; existing images stay unchanged.
shortZh: 用于后续季节版本，不会自动重新生成已有图片。
shortEn: Used for new seasonal variants; existing images stay unchanged.

zh: 按镜头俯角切换：水平 0°，正俯视 90°。
en: Switches by camera elevation: horizontal 0°, top-down 90°.
shortZh: 按镜头俯角切换：水平 0°，正俯视 90°。
shortEn: Switches by camera elevation: horizontal 0°, top-down 90°.

zh: 平面抬升比例 · 实际树高 × 比例
en: Plan lift · actual tree height × ratio
shortZh: 平面抬升比例 · 实际树高 × 比例
shortEn: Plan lift · actual tree height × ratio

zh: 自动：低角度沿 Z 轴，过渡后朝向相机，高俯视使用平面。平面缺失时暂用立面。
en: Auto: Z axis at low angles, face camera after transition, plan at high angles. Missing plans use elevation temporarily.
shortZh: 自动：低角度沿 Z 轴，过渡后朝向相机，高俯视使用平面。平面缺失时暂用立面。
shortEn: Auto: Z axis at low angles, face camera after transition, plan at high angles. Missing plans use elevation temporarily.

zh: 已保存 · 当前场景已刷新
shortZh: 已保存 · 当前场景已刷新

zh: 环境检测不可用；其他设置仍可使用。
en: Environment detection is unavailable; other settings remain usable.
shortZh: 环境检测不可用；其他设置仍可使用。
shortEn: Environment detection is unavailable; other settings remain usable.

zh: 连接状态更新失败，请在设置中重新检测。
en: Connection refresh failed. Check again in Settings.
shortZh: 连接状态更新失败，请在设置中重新检测。
shortEn: Connection refresh failed. Check again in Settings.

zh: 首次使用会自动检测，不会生成图片或消耗生图额度。
en: The first check runs automatically without generating images or using image quota.
shortZh: 首次使用会自动检测，不会生成图片或消耗生图额度。
shortEn: The first check runs automatically without generating images or using image quota.

zh: 运行环境未就绪，请前往设置检测或修复安装。
en: Runtime is not ready. Check the environment or repair installation in Settings.
shortZh: 运行环境未就绪，请前往设置检测或修复安装。
shortEn: Runtime is not ready. Check the environment or repair installation in Settings.

zh: 未找到 Codex，请前往设置查看安装与登录方法。
en: Codex was not found. Open Settings for installation and sign-in.
shortZh: 未找到 Codex，请前往设置查看安装与登录方法。
shortEn: Codex was not found. Open Settings for installation and sign-in.

zh: 尚未验证 ChatGPT 授权，请前往设置登录或重新检测。
en: ChatGPT authorization is not verified. Sign in or check again in Settings.
shortZh: 尚未验证 ChatGPT 授权，请前往设置登录或重新检测。
shortEn: ChatGPT authorization is not verified. Sign in or check again in Settings.

zh: WebView2 未就绪，请修复安装后重新检测。
en: WebView2 is not ready. Repair installation, then check again.
shortZh: WebView2 未就绪，请修复安装后重新检测。
shortEn: WebView2 is not ready. Repair installation, then check again.

zh: 聊天未能启动，请在设置中重新检测。
en: Chat could not start. Check again in Settings.
shortZh: 聊天未能启动，请在设置中重新检测。
shortEn: Chat could not start. Check again in Settings.
